newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ not looking to buy another bank.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ not looking to buy another bank.

text.p: Australian and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Wednesday it was not looking to take over another bank, nor to be a takeover target itself.
"We are not looking to take over another bank. We are not looking to be taken over," said ANZ Chairman Charles Goode told the shareholders at the bank's annual general meeting.

He was responding ot a question from the Australian Shareholders' Association, which wanted to know if the bank was taking any defensive measures to protect it from takeover after the findings of the Wallis inquiry into Australia's financial system were handed down in March. -- Sydney 61-2 9373-1800
